data.name: Terminal Madness - Revelations
data.detailed_description:
A mind-bending sci-fi point-and-click adventure

Join Crypto, a sharp-witted hacker, and Dana, a fearless explorer, as they investigate the GLOBAL GLITCH

— A phenomenon where advanced technology and ancient magic collide. Search for the mysterious OMNIA Prototype and its lost blueprints across a strange, beautifully crafted world.

Solve clever puzzles, uncover secrets, and follow a story full of intrigue, humour, and heart.

A vibrant world to explore

Inspired by the expressive charm of classic adventure games, Terminal Madness: Revelations features hand-crafted, cartoony visuals, quirky characters, glowing circuitry, mysterious runes, and more than 60 distinct locations.

Features list 

· A story-driven sci-fi mystery with magical twists

· Clever puzzles and optional in-game hints

· Play as Crypto and Dana, two unlikely partners

· More than 60 hand-crafted locations to explore

· A complete premium adventure made with care

Uncover the truth behind the GLOBAL GLITCH, if your mind can keep up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 512MB RAM and Webgl enabled
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 4096MB RAM and Webgl enabled
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
